LESSON: CUTTING TOOLS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Cutting Tools

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Cutting Tools. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Cutting Tools
2. Practise Cutting Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Cutting Tools

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Cutting Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Cutting Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Cutting Tools at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Cutting Tools at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Cutting Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Cutting Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Cutting Tools using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Cutting Tools in the examples.
2. Explain Cutting Tools to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Cutting Tools.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Cutting Tools using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Cutting Tools important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Cutting Tools
2. Practise Cutting Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Cutting Tools

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
